# Platform address map

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_regmap.py from regmap/system.yaml. Do not edit. -->

ZedBoard mixed-signal platform (ADC + DAC + OLED over AXI4-Lite).

Register-map ABI: **1.0.0**. Host drivers refuse a bitstream whose major version they do not know.

| Base | Instance | Block | Registers | Description |
| ---- | -------- | ----- | --------- | ----------- |
| `0x43C00000` | `sysid` | [`sysid`](sysid.md) | 6 | Bitstream identification and scratch. |
| `0x43C10000` | `adc` | [`adc_ad7476`](adc_ad7476.md) | 7 | PmodAD1 sampling front end. |
| `0x43C20000` | `dac` | [`dac_spi`](dac_spi.md) | 6 | PmodDA2/DA3 output stage. |
| `0x43C30000` | `oled` | [`oled_ctrl`](oled_ctrl.md) | 6 | Text-mode display controller. |
